mentions.name: streambed
mentions.description: An analytics database built on S3 and DuckDB, providing a simpler alternative to setting up additional read replicas or Snowflake for BI analytics workloads.
mentions.problem: BI teams require extra read replicas and Snowflake for analytics, which is tiring to set up.
mentions.audience: Tired of provisioning read replicas and Snowflake for BI teams; this analytics database on S3 and DuckDB simplifies that setup.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was tired of setting up additional read replicas and Snowflake for our BI teams, I built an analytics database using S3 and DuckDB.

evidence.value: I was tired of setting up additional read replicas and Snowflake for our BI teams, I built an analytics database using S3 and DuckDB.
